entries.name: GravityArchitecture.scale_squared
entries.exact_statement:
theorem scale_squared (κ c G ρ : ℝ) (h : 0 ≤ G * ρ) :
    accelerationScale κ c G ρ ^ 2 = κ ^ 2 * c ^ 2 * G * ρ

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.vacuum_coefficient
entries.exact_statement:
theorem vacuum_coefficient (κ c G ρ Λ : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hρ : 0 ≤ G * ρ) (hΛ : Λ = 8 * Real.pi * G * ρ / c ^ 2) :
    accelerationScale κ c G ρ ^ 2 = κ ^ 2 * Λ * c ^ 4 / (8 * Real.pi)

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.half_kappa_32pi
entries.exact_statement:
theorem half_kappa_32pi (c G ρ Λ : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hρ : 0 ≤ G * ρ) (hΛ : Λ = 8 * Real.pi * G * ρ / c ^ 2) :
    accelerationScale (1 / 2) c G ρ ^ 2 = Λ * c ^ 4 / (32 * Real.pi)

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.coefficient_family
entries.exact_statement:
theorem coefficient_family (κ c G ρ : ℝ) (h : 0 ≤ G * ρ) :
    ∃ a₀ : ℝ, a₀ = accelerationScale κ c G ρ ∧
      a₀ ^ 2 = κ ^ 2 * c ^ 2 * G * ρ

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.baryonic_quartic
entries.exact_statement:
theorem baryonic_quartic (G M a₀ r V : ℝ)
    (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ha : 0 ≤ a₀) (hr : 0 < r)
    (horbit : V ^ 2 / r = deepAcceleration G M a₀ r) :
    V ^ 4 = G * M * a₀

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.target_mass_unique
entries.exact_statement:
theorem target_mass_unique (G Mb Mc r ν : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hforce : G * (Mb + Mc) / r ^ 2 = ν * (G * Mb / r ^ 2)) :
    Mc = (ν - 1) * Mb

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.target_mass_sufficient
entries.exact_statement:
theorem target_mass_sufficient (G Mb r ν : ℝ) :
    G * (Mb + (ν - 1) * Mb) / r ^ 2 = ν * (G * Mb / r ^ 2)

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.target_mass_nonnegative_iff
entries.exact_statement:
theorem target_mass_nonnegative_iff (Mb ν : ℝ) (hM : 0 < Mb) :
    0 ≤ (ν - 1) * Mb ↔ 1 ≤ ν

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.tail_mass_derivative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem tail_mass_derivative (A Mb r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (tailColdMass A Mb) A r

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.tail_density
entries.exact_statement:
theorem tail_density (A Mb r ρ : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hmass : 4 * Real.pi * r ^ 2 * ρ = deriv (tailColdMass A Mb) r) :
    ρ = A / (4 * Real.pi * r ^ 2)

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.supply_radius_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem supply_radius_bound (A Mb S r : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hsupply : tailColdMass A Mb r ≤ S) :
    r ≤ (S + Mb) / A

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.no_finite_supply_for_infinite_tail
entries.exact_statement:
theorem no_finite_supply_for_infinite_tail (A Mb S : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    ¬ (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → tailColdMass A Mb r ≤ S)

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.nonlensing_residual
entries.exact_statement:
theorem nonlensing_residual (gb gc gs gd gl : ℝ)
    (hd : gd = gb + gc + gs) (hl : gl = gb + gc) :
    gd - gl = gs

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.matched_lensing_forces_zero_extra
entries.exact_statement:
theorem matched_lensing_forces_zero_extra (gb gc gs gd gl : ℝ)
    (hd : gd = gb + gc + gs) (hl : gl = gb + gc) (hm : gd = gl) :
    gs = 0

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.exchange_conserves_total
entries.exact_statement:
theorem exchange_conserves_total {ι : Type*} (Dc Dr Q : ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, Dc i = Q i) (hr : ∀ i, Dr i = -Q i) :
    ∀ i, Dc i + Dr i = 0

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.passive_vacuum_no_exchange
entries.exact_statement:
theorem passive_vacuum_no_exchange {ι : Type*} (Dv Q : ι → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ i, Dv i = 0) (hexchange : ∀ i, Dv i = -Q i) :
    ∀ i, Q i = 0

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.response_energy_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem response_energy_nonnegative (C β mismatchSq p : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hm : 0 ≤ mismatchSq) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    0 ≤ C / 2 * mismatchSq + β / 3 * p ^ 3

entries.name: GravityArchitecture.distinct_mass_scalings
entries.exact_statement:
theorem distinct_mass_scalings (K L M₁ M₂ : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hM₁ : 0 < M₁) (hM₂ : 0 < M₂) (hne : M₁ ≠ M₂)
    (h₁ : K * M₁ = L * M₁ ^ 2) :
    K * M₂ ≠ L * M₂ ^ 2

entries.name: StaticIsNotAttractor.shared_equilibrium
entries.exact_statement: theorem shared_equilibrium (rate target : ℝ) : transfer rate target target = 0

entries.name: StaticIsNotAttractor.mass_ledger
entries.exact_statement:
theorem mass_ledger (rate target q : ℝ) :
    transfer rate target q + (-transfer rate target q) = 0

entries.name: StaticIsNotAttractor.energy_ledger
entries.exact_statement:
theorem energy_ledger (D rate target q : ℝ) :
    D * transfer rate target q + (-D * transfer rate target q) = 0

entries.name: StaticIsNotAttractor.squared_error_rate
entries.exact_statement:
theorem squared_error_rate (rate target q : ℝ) :
    2 * (q - target) * transfer rate target q = -2 * rate * (q - target)^2

entries.name: StaticIsNotAttractor.positive_rate_decreases
entries.exact_statement:
theorem positive_rate_decreases (rate target q : ℝ) (hr : 0 < rate)
    (hne : q ≠ target) : 2 * (q - target) * transfer rate target q < 0

entries.name: StaticIsNotAttractor.negative_rate_increases
entries.exact_statement:
theorem negative_rate_increases (rate target q : ℝ) (hr : rate < 0)
    (hne : q ≠ target) : 0 < 2 * (q - target) * transfer rate target q

entries.name: StaticIsNotAttractor.admissible_unstable_state
entries.exact_statement:
theorem admissible_unstable_state (B target ε : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < target) (he : 0 < ε) (hs : target + ε < B) :
    0 < target + ε ∧ 0 < B - (target + ε) ∧
    transfer (-1) target target = 0 ∧
    transfer (-1) target (target + ε) + (-transfer (-1) target (target + ε)) = 0 ∧
    0 < 2 * ((target + ε) - target) * transfer (-1) target (target + ε)

entries.name: FrameworkVacuumLink.response_derivative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem response_derivative (W0 A B x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (responsePotential W0 A B) (response A B x) x

entries.name: FrameworkVacuumLink.offset_invisible_to_response
entries.exact_statement:
theorem offset_invisible_to_response (W0 δ A B x : ℝ) :
    deriv (responsePotential (W0 + δ) A B) x =
      deriv (responsePotential W0 A B) x

entries.name: FrameworkVacuumLink.offset_ratio_change
entries.exact_statement:
theorem offset_ratio_change (G W0 a δ : ℝ) :
    ratio G (W0 + δ) a - ratio G W0 a = G * δ / a ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkVacuumLink.factor_four_iff_offset
entries.exact_statement:
theorem factor_four_iff_offset (G W0 a : ℝ) (hG : G ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ratio G W0 a = 4 ↔ W0 = 4 * a ^ 2 / G

entries.name: FrameworkVacuumLink.factor_four_iff_half
entries.exact_statement:
theorem factor_four_iff_half (κ G W0 : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hGW : 0 < G * W0) :
    ratio G W0 (scale κ G W0) = 4 ↔ κ = 1 / 2

entries.name: FrameworkVacuumLink.coefficient_not_selected
entries.exact_statement:
theorem coefficient_not_selected :
    0 < (1 : ℝ) ∧ 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
    scale 1 1 1 = 1 ∧ scale (1 / 2) 1 1 = 1 / 2 ∧
    ratio 1 1 (scale 1 1 1) = 1 ∧
    ratio 1 1 (scale (1 / 2) 1 1) = 4

entries.name: FrameworkVacuumLink.fixed_response_different_vacuum_ratio
entries.exact_statement:
theorem fixed_response_different_vacuum_ratio (A B x : ℝ) :
    deriv (responsePotential 1 A B) x = deriv (responsePotential 4 A B) x ∧
    ratio 1 1 1 = 1 ∧ ratio 1 4 1 = 4

entries.name: FrameworkEdgePower.integrand_rpow
entries.exact_statement:
theorem integrand_rpow (K q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    integrand K q = K * q ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ)

entries.name: FrameworkEdgePower.primitive_derivative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem primitive_derivative (K q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    HasDerivAt (primitive K) (integrand K q) q

entries.name: FrameworkEdgePower.integral_exact
entries.exact_statement:
theorem integral_exact (K ε Q : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεQ : ε ≤ Q) :
    (∫ q in ε..Q, integrand K q) = truncatedPower K ε Q

entries.name: FrameworkEdgePower.integral_unbounded
entries.exact_statement:
theorem integral_unbounded (K Q cap : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < Q ∧ cap < ∫ q in ε..Q, integrand K q

entries.name: FrameworkEdgePower.lower_bound_integral_unbounded
entries.exact_statement:
theorem lower_bound_integral_unbounded (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K Q cap : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hint : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < Q → IntervalIntegrable f volume ε Q)
    (hbound : ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ Q → integrand K q ≤ f q) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < Q ∧ cap < ∫ q in ε..Q, f q

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverChannel.energy_degeneracy
entries.exact_statement:
theorem energy_degeneracy (D p p1 p2 g1 g2 : ℝ) :
    D * determinant p1 p2 g1 g2 +
      p1 * reaction1 D p p2 g2 + p2 * reaction2 D p p1 g1 = 0

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverChannel.momentum_degeneracy
entries.exact_statement:
theorem momentum_degeneracy (D p p1 p2 g1 g2 : ℝ) :
    determinant p1 p2 g1 g2 * p -
      g1 * reaction1 D p p2 g2 - g2 * reaction2 D p p1 g1 = 0

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverChannel.collision_mass
entries.exact_statement: theorem collision_mass (a : ℝ) : -a-a+a+a=0

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverChannel.consumed_boundary_inward
entries.exact_statement:
theorem consumed_boundary_inward (γ h f2 f3 f4 : ℝ)
    (hg : 0 ≤ γ) (h3 : 0 ≤ f3) (h4 : 0 ≤ f4) :
    0 ≤ -flux γ h 0 f2 f3 f4

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverChannel.product_boundary_inward
entries.exact_statement:
theorem product_boundary_inward (γ h f1 f2 f4 : ℝ)
    (hg : 0 ≤ γ) (h1 : 0 ≤ f1) (h2 : 0 ≤ f2) :
    0 ≤ flux γ h f1 f2 0 f4

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverChannel.zero_determinant_freezes
entries.exact_statement:
theorem zero_determinant_freezes (γ f1 f2 f3 f4 : ℝ) :
    flux γ 0 f1 f2 f3 f4 = 0

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.omega_squared
entries.exact_statement: theorem omega_squared (c k : ℝ) : omega c k ^ 2 = c ^ 2 * k ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.energy_momentum_squares
entries.exact_statement:
theorem energy_momentum_squares (c k p1 p2 x1 x2 : ℝ) :
    energy c k p1 p2 x1 x2 ^ 2 - c ^ 2 * momentum k p1 p2 x1 x2 ^ 2 =
      (p1 ^ 2 + p2 ^ 2 - omega c k ^ 2 * (x1 ^ 2 + x2 ^ 2)) ^ 2 / 4 +
        omega c k ^ 2 * (p1 * x1 + p2 * x2) ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.energy_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem energy_nonnegative (c k p1 p2 x1 x2 : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ energy c k p1 p2 x1 x2

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.receiver_floor
entries.exact_statement:
theorem receiver_floor (c k p1 p2 x1 x2 : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    c * |momentum k p1 p2 x1 x2| ≤ energy c k p1 p2 x1 x2

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.accessible_transfer
entries.exact_statement:
theorem accessible_transfer (c k p1 p2 x1 x2 E0 Δ P0 pb q : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hE : energy c k p1 p2 x1 x2 = E0 - Δ)
    (hP : momentum k p1 p2 x1 x2 = P0 - pb * q) :
    c * |P0 - pb * q| ≤ E0 - Δ

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.recoil_budget
entries.exact_statement:
theorem recoil_budget (c D pb E0 q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (haccess : c * |0 - pb * q| ≤ E0 - D * q) :
    (D + c * |pb|) * q ≤ E0

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.necessary_capacity_ratio
entries.exact_statement:
theorem necessary_capacity_ratio (c D pb E0 qeq : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hqeq : 0 < qeq)
    (haccess : c * |0 - pb * qeq| ≤ E0 - D * qeq) :
    1 + c * |pb| / D ≤ E0 / (D * qeq)

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.slow_recoil_ratio
entries.exact_statement:
theorem slow_recoil_ratio (ε E0 qeq : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hqeq : 0 < qeq)
    (haccess : |0 - (-2 * ε) * qeq| ≤ E0 - (2 * ε ^ 2) * qeq) :
    1 + 1 / ε ≤ E0 / ((2 * ε ^ 2) * qeq)

entries.name: FrameworkReceiverCapacity.slow_recoil_fraction
entries.exact_statement:
theorem slow_recoil_fraction (ε r q qeq : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hqeq : 0 < qeq)
    (haccess : |0 - (-2 * ε) * q| ≤ r * (2 * ε ^ 2) * qeq - (2 * ε ^ 2) * q) :
    q / qeq ≤ r * ε / (1 + ε)

entries.name: FrameworkLocalPower.cold_power_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem cold_power_nonnegative (A x : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    0 ≤ coldPower A x

entries.name: FrameworkLocalPower.cold_total
entries.exact_statement:
theorem cold_total (A : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..2 * Real.pi, coldPower A x) = A

entries.name: FrameworkLocalPower.mode_total
entries.exact_statement:
theorem mode_total (A : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..2 * Real.pi, modePower A x) = -A

entries.name: FrameworkLocalPower.integrated_ledger
entries.exact_statement:
theorem integrated_ledger (A : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..2 * Real.pi, coldPower A x) +
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..2 * Real.pi, modePower A x) = 0

entries.name: FrameworkLocalPower.pointwise_ledger_fails
entries.exact_statement:
theorem pointwise_ledger_fails (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    coldPower A 0 = 0 ∧ coldPower A 0 + modePower A 0 < 0

entries.name: FrameworkScalarCompatibility.source_compatibility
entries.exact_statement:
theorem source_compatibility (pi gradient S q m : ℝ)
    (hE : pi*S = -q) (hP : gradient*S = m) :
    gradient*q + pi*m = 0

entries.name: FrameworkScalarCompatibility.zero_recoil_requires_flat
entries.exact_statement:
theorem zero_recoil_requires_flat (pi gradient S q : ℝ)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hE : pi*S = -q) (hP : gradient*S = 0) :
    gradient=0

entries.name: FrameworkScalarCompatibility.no_source_for_unit_heat_zero_recoil
entries.exact_statement:
theorem no_source_for_unit_heat_zero_recoil :
    ¬ ∃ S : ℝ, (1 : ℝ)*S = -1 ∧ (1 : ℝ)*S = 0

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierRate.speed_positive
entries.exact_statement: theorem speed_positive (M Δ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hΔ : 0 < Δ) : 0 < speed M Δ

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierRate.speed_kinematic
entries.exact_statement:
theorem speed_kinematic (M Δ : ℝ) (hM : M ≠ 0) (hΔ : 0 ≤ Δ) :
    M ^ 2 * speed M Δ ^ 2 = Δ

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierRate.speed_less_than_one
entries.exact_statement:
theorem speed_less_than_one (M Δ m : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (hgap : Δ = M ^ 2 - 4 * m ^ 2) : speed M Δ < 1

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierRate.rate_margin
entries.exact_statement:
theorem rate_margin (M Δ g rep lam Γ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (hlam : lam = rep + g ^ 2 / Δ)
    (hΓ : Γ = g ^ 2 * speed M Δ / (8 * Real.pi * M)) :
    lam * speed M Δ ^ 3 / (8 * Real.pi) - Γ / M =
      rep * speed M Δ ^ 3 / (8 * Real.pi)

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierRate.coldness_rate_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem coldness_rate_bound (M Δ g rep lam Γ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) (hlam : lam = rep + g ^ 2 / Δ)
    (hΓ : Γ = g ^ 2 * speed M Δ / (8 * Real.pi * M)) :
    Γ / M ≤ lam * speed M Δ ^ 3 / (8 * Real.pi)

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierRate.lifetime_floor
entries.exact_statement:
theorem lifetime_floor (M Δ g rep lam Γ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) (hlam : lam = rep + g ^ 2 / Δ)
    (hΓ : Γ = g ^ 2 * speed M Δ / (8 * Real.pi * M)) (hΓpos : 0 < Γ) :
    8 * Real.pi / (lam * speed M Δ ^ 3) ≤ M / Γ

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierRate.positive_repulsion_strict
entries.exact_statement:
theorem positive_repulsion_strict (M Δ g rep lam Γ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (hrep : 0 < rep) (hlam : lam = rep + g ^ 2 / Δ)
    (hΓ : Γ = g ^ 2 * speed M Δ / (8 * Real.pi * M)) :
    Γ / M < lam * speed M Δ ^ 3 / (8 * Real.pi)

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierRate.zero_repulsion_saturates
entries.exact_statement:
theorem zero_repulsion_saturates (M Δ g lam Γ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (hlam : lam = g ^ 2 / Δ)
    (hΓ : Γ = g ^ 2 * speed M Δ / (8 * Real.pi * M)) :
    Γ / M = lam * speed M Δ ^ 3 / (8 * Real.pi)

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.four_coordinate_squares
entries.exact_statement:
theorem four_coordinate_squares (a b c d v w x y : ℝ) :
    (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) * (v ^ 2 + w ^ 2 + x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) -
      (a * v + b * w + c * x + d * y) ^ 2 =
    (a * w - b * v) ^ 2 + (a * x - c * v) ^ 2 + (a * y - d * v) ^ 2 +
      (b * x - c * w) ^ 2 + (b * y - d * w) ^ 2 + (c * y - d * x) ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.four_coordinate_cauchy
entries.exact_statement:
theorem four_coordinate_cauchy (a b c d v w x y : ℝ) :
    (a * v + b * w + c * x + d * y) ^ 2 ≤
      (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) * (v ^ 2 + w ^ 2 + x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.charge_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem charge_bound (r1 r2 r3 r4 v1 v2 v3 v4 : ℝ) :
    charge r1 r2 r3 r4 v1 v2 v3 v4 ^ 2 ≤
      4 * amplitude r1 r2 r3 r4 * kinetic v1 v2 v3 v4

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.positive_square_potential
entries.exact_statement:
theorem positive_square_potential (m S u1 u2 rep phiSq : ℝ) (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) :
    m ^ 2 * S ≤ potential m S u1 u2 rep phiSq

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.homogeneous_stress_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem homogeneous_stress_bound (m S K V q : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hcharge : q ^ 2 ≤ 4 * S * K) (hV : m ^ 2 * S ≤ V) :
    m ^ 2 * q ^ 2 ≤ rho K V ^ 2 - pressure K V ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.coordinate_stress_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem coordinate_stress_bound (m r1 r2 r3 r4 v1 v2 v3 v4 u1 u2 rep phiSq : ℝ)
    (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) :
    m ^ 2 * charge r1 r2 r3 r4 v1 v2 v3 v4 ^ 2 ≤
      rho (kinetic v1 v2 v3 v4) (potential m (amplitude r1 r2 r3 r4) u1 u2 rep phiSq) ^ 2 -
      pressure (kinetic v1 v2 v3 v4) (potential m (amplitude r1 r2 r3 r4) u1 u2 rep phiSq) ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.exact_negative_one
entries.exact_statement:
theorem exact_negative_one (S K V q : ℝ) (hcharge : q ^ 2 ≤ 4 * S * K)
    (hrho : 0 < rho K V) (hw : pressure K V / rho K V = -1) : K = 0 ∧ q = 0

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.saturated_pressure_zero
entries.exact_statement:
theorem saturated_pressure_zero (m S K V q : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hcharge : q ^ 2 ≤ 4 * S * K) (hV : m ^ 2 * S ≤ V)
    (hsat : rho K V ^ 2 = m ^ 2 * q ^ 2) : pressure K V = 0

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.isotropic_stress_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem isotropic_stress_bound (m S K B V q : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hcharge : q ^ 2 ≤ 4 * S * K) (hV : m ^ 2 * S ≤ V) :
    m ^ 2 * q ^ 2 ≤ gradientRho K B V ^ 2 - isotropicPressure K B V ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.isotropic_exact_negative_one
entries.exact_statement:
theorem isotropic_exact_negative_one (S K B V q : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hcharge : q ^ 2 ≤ 4 * S * K) (hrho : 0 < gradientRho K B V)
    (hw : isotropicPressure K B V / gradientRho K B V = -1) : K = 0 ∧ B = 0 ∧ q = 0

entries.name: FrameworkCarrierStress.actual_carrier_stress_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem actual_carrier_stress_bound (m Δ g rep r1 r2 r3 r4 v1 v2 v3 v4 : ℝ)
    (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) :
    m ^ 2 * charge r1 r2 r3 r4 v1 v2 v3 v4 ^ 2 ≤
      rho (kinetic v1 v2 v3 v4) (actualPotential m Δ g rep r1 r2 r3 r4) ^ 2 -
      pressure (kinetic v1 v2 v3 v4) (actualPotential m Δ g rep r1 r2 r3 r4) ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.c3_squared
entries.exact_statement:
theorem c3_squared (m M g : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    c3 m M g ^ 2 = g ^ 2 / (8 * m ^ 2 * M)

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.coefficient_identity
entries.exact_statement:
theorem coefficient_identity (m M g rep : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 2 * m < M) :
    remainder m M g rep = rep / (4 * m ^ 2) + g ^ 2 / (8 * m ^ 2 * M * (M + 2 * m))

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.remainder_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem remainder_nonnegative (m M g rep : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 2 * m < M)
    (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) : 0 ≤ remainder m M g rep

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.remainder_strict
entries.exact_statement:
theorem remainder_strict (m M g rep : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 2 * m < M)
    (hrep : 0 < rep) : 0 < remainder m M g rep

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.exact_square_completion
entries.exact_statement:
theorem exact_square_completion (m M g rep x y u v : ℝ) (hd : delta m M ≠ 0) :
    density m M g rep x y u v = completedDensity m M g rep x y u v

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.density_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem density_nonnegative (m M g rep x y u v : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hM : 2 * m < M) (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) : 0 ≤ density m M g rep x y u v

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.finite_energy_bounds
entries.exact_statement:
theorem finite_energy_bounds {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m M g rep T : ℝ)
    (x y u v weights : ι → ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 2 * m < M) (hrep : 0 ≤ rep)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ weights i) :
    0 ≤ T ∧ T ≤ T + ∑ i ∈ s, weights i * density m M g rep (x i) (y i) (u i) (v i)

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.gradient_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem gradient_nonnegative (m M a b : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M) :
    0 ≤ gradientTerm m M a b

entries.name: FrameworkNREnergy.finite_gradient_energy_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem finite_gradient_energy_nonnegative {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m M : ℝ)
    (a b weights : ι → ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ weights i) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, weights i * gradientTerm m M (a i) (b i)

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.real_derivative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem real_derivative (δ c F t : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (realPart δ c F) (-c * F * Real.sin (δ * t)) t

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.imag_derivative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem imag_derivative (δ c F t : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (imagPart δ c F) (-c * F * Real.cos (δ * t)) t

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.driven_source_ode
entries.exact_statement:
theorem driven_source_ode (δ c F t : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    -deriv (imagPart δ c F) t = δ * realPart δ c F t + c * F ∧
      deriv (realPart δ c F) t = δ * imagPart δ c F t

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.zero_initial_source
entries.exact_statement: theorem zero_initial_source (δ c F : ℝ) : realPart δ c F 0 = 0 ∧ imagPart δ c F 0 = 0

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.storage_exact
entries.exact_statement:
theorem storage_exact (δ c F t : ℝ) :
    storage δ c F t = 2 * c ^ 2 * F ^ 2 / δ ^ 2 * (1 - Real.cos (δ * t))

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.storage_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement: theorem storage_nonnegative (δ c F t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ storage δ c F t

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.storage_derivative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem storage_derivative (δ c F t : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (storage δ c F) (2 * c ^ 2 * F ^ 2 / δ * Real.sin (δ * t)) t

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.opposite_storage_power
entries.exact_statement:
theorem opposite_storage_power (δ c F : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcf : c * F ≠ 0) :
    0 < deriv (storage δ c F) (Real.pi / (2 * δ)) ∧
      deriv (storage δ c F) (3 * Real.pi / (2 * δ)) < 0

entries.name: FrameworkSourceResponse.storage_and_return
entries.exact_statement:
theorem storage_and_return (δ c F : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcf : c * F ≠ 0) :
    0 < storage δ c F (Real.pi / δ) ∧ storage δ c F (2 * Real.pi / δ) = 0

entries.name: FrameworkQuantumEnergy.quadratic_form_completion
entries.exact_statement:
theorem quadratic_form_completion (δ c k : ℝ) (A B : E →L[ℂ] F) (v : E) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    interactionForm δ c k A B v =
      δ * ‖B v + ((c / δ : ℝ) : ℂ) • A v‖ ^ 2 + (k - c ^ 2 / δ) * ‖A v‖ ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkQuantumEnergy.adjoint_form_correspondence
entries.exact_statement:
theorem adjoint_form_correspondence (δ c k : ℝ) (A B : E →L[ℂ] F) (v : E) :
    RCLike.re (inner ℂ v (interactionOperator δ c k A B v)) = interactionForm δ c k A B v

entries.name: FrameworkQuantumEnergy.interaction_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem interaction_nonnegative (δ c k : ℝ) (A B : E →L[ℂ] F) (v : E)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hk : 0 ≤ k - c ^ 2 / δ) : 0 ≤ interactionForm δ c k A B v

entries.name: FrameworkQuantumEnergy.actual_nr_interaction_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem actual_nr_interaction_nonnegative (m M g rep : ℝ) (A B : E →L[ℂ] F) (v : E)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 2 * m < M) (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) :
    0 ≤ interactionForm (FrameworkNREnergy.delta m M) (FrameworkNREnergy.c3 m M g)
      (FrameworkNREnergy.quartic m M g rep) A B v

entries.name: FrameworkQuantumEnergy.actual_nr_energy_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem actual_nr_energy_bound (m M g rep : ℝ) (A B : E →L[ℂ] F) (T : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (v : E) (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 2 * m < M) (hrep : 0 ≤ rep)
    (hT : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (inner ℂ v (T v))) :
    0 ≤ RCLike.re (inner ℂ v (T v)) ∧
      RCLike.re (inner ℂ v (T v)) ≤
        RCLike.re (inner ℂ v ((T + interactionOperator (FrameworkNREnergy.delta m M)
          (FrameworkNREnergy.c3 m M g) (FrameworkNREnergy.quartic m M g rep) A B) v))

entries.name: FrameworkQuantumEnergy.finite_regulator_form_bound
entries.exact_statement:
theorem finite_regulator_form_bound {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m M g rep : ℝ)
    (A B : ι → E →L[ℂ] F) (weights : ι → ℝ) (T : E →L[ℂ] E) (v : E)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 2 * m < M) (hrep : 0 ≤ rep)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ weights i) (hT : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (inner ℂ v (T v))) :
    0 ≤ RCLike.re (inner ℂ v (T v)) ∧
      RCLike.re (inner ℂ v (T v)) ≤ RCLike.re (inner ℂ v (T v)) +
        ∑ i ∈ s, weights i * interactionForm (FrameworkNREnergy.delta m M)
          (FrameworkNREnergy.c3 m M g) (FrameworkNREnergy.quartic m M g rep) (A i) (B i) v

entries.name: FrameworkQuantumEnergy.cell_normalized_interaction_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem cell_normalized_interaction_nonnegative (m M g rep volume : ℝ)
    (A B : E →L[ℂ] F) (v : E) (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 2 * m < M)
    (hrep : 0 ≤ rep) (hvolume : 0 < volume) :
    0 ≤ interactionForm (FrameworkNREnergy.delta m M)
      (FrameworkNREnergy.c3 m M g / Real.sqrt volume)
      (FrameworkNREnergy.quartic m M g rep / volume) A B v

entries.name: FrameworkEventStress.completed_stress_identity
entries.exact_statement:
theorem completed_stress_identity (E₁ E₂ a b : ℝ)
    (h₁ : E₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : E₂ ≠ 0) (hs : E₁ + E₂ ≠ 0) :
    stressJump E₁ E₂ a b =
      E₁ * E₂ / (E₁ + E₂) * (a / E₁ - b / E₂) ^ 2

entries.name: FrameworkEventStress.completed_stress_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem completed_stress_nonnegative (E₁ E₂ a b : ℝ)
    (h₁ : 0 < E₁) (h₂ : 0 < E₂) : 0 ≤ stressJump E₁ E₂ a b

entries.name: FrameworkEventStress.projected_relative_motion_strict
entries.exact_statement:
theorem projected_relative_motion_strict (E₁ E₂ a b : ℝ)
    (h₁ : 0 < E₁) (h₂ : 0 < E₂) (hv : a / E₁ ≠ b / E₂) :
    0 < stressJump E₁ E₂ a b

entries.name: FrameworkEventStress.every_spatial_projection_nonnegative
entries.exact_statement:
theorem every_spatial_projection_nonnegative {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (E₁ E₂ : ℝ) (p₁ p₂ z : ι → ℝ) (h₁ : 0 < E₁) (h₂ : 0 < E₂) :
    0 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, z i * p₁ i) ^ 2 / E₁ +
      (∑ i ∈ s, z i * p₂ i) ^ 2 / E₂ -
        (∑ i ∈ s, z i * (p₁ i + p₂ i)) ^ 2 / (E₁ + E₂)
